title: Tʼaqhesit alman pacienciapa
intro: Historia anales ukanx mä jaqiw utji, jupan sutipax aguantañamp sasiwa. Uka jaqejj akapachankir taqe chuymachtʼäwinakap aptʼasisaw yantʼat uñjasïna, ukampis Lurir Diosar taqe chuyma servirjamaw qheparäna. Walja maranakaw jan walt’äwinakampi, janchi usunakampi, uka almax chuymapax iyawsäwin anclatäskäna, taqi jan walt’äwinakar puripki ukanakatakix mä suyt’äwiw utjäna.
clues: Nayax Allah-an taqi chuyma luqtiripäyätwa, walja qamir yänakampi, walja wawanakampi ukat wali k’umaräñampiw bendicitäna.
Jakäwijajj mayjtʼawayiwa, kunapachatï qamirïtajsa familiajatsa aptʼasipjjetäna ukhajja, janiw kunas utj-jjänti, jan ukasti iyawsäwijakiw utjäna.
Nayajj jaya tiempo ukat wali tʼaqhesiñ usumpiw tʼaqhesiyäta, uka usujj jaqenakan aguantañ yatipjjatap yantʼäna.
Taqi tʼaqhisiñanakajanxa, janiw Tatitujat quejasiñ munkayätti, uñisirix jan suytʼäwir irpañ munkäna ukhasa.
Qhepatjja, Tatitujar jawsayäta ukhajja, janiw qamirïñ maytʼkti, jan ukasti llakisiñaw chuym chʼalljjtayitu sasaw amuyayäta.
Nayarojj kayujampiw aka oraqe jawqʼjañama sasaw sapjjetäna, ukatwa thaya uma phuchʼu mistunïna, cuerpojar qollañataki, umat pharjañajataki.

arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verse: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink." (38:42)
